basic_profile.bio: I'm a 23-year-old tech enthusiast based in the UK, currently balancing my time between learning game development and working part-time in retail. I'm new to the Reddit community and still exploring different subreddits to find my niche. I love discussing technology, especially game development and coding in Unity, and I'm a huge fan of indie games. When I'm not online, I enjoy outdoor adventures and am trying to learn Danish as a hobby. I'm single and usually online during the evenings and late nights.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I am self-taught in game development, primarily using online tutorials and community forums. My interest in coding began with a high school computer science class, and I've been exploring Unity through online courses and experimentation since then.
